theater: 拉達克卡吉爾山區前線

battle.name: 卡吉爾戰爭
battle.theater: 拉達克卡吉爾山區前線
battle.brief: 1999年5月至7月，巴基斯坦軍方以北方之光步兵滲入印控克什米爾控制線一側山脊，印度陸軍以「勝利行動」逐點反攻，奪回虎山等關鍵高地。卡面BMP-2是巴軍機械化步兵的核心裝甲載具，曾隨前突部隊進駐高地堡壘，以30公厘機炮支援守點，最終在無遮蔽山脊上被印度直瞄火力與空軍精確炸彈獵殺。

kit.name: BMP-2步兵戰鬥車
kit.history: 蘇聯陸軍機械化步兵的核心裝甲載具，負責伴隨坦克輸送兵員，並以機炮提供伴隨步兵火力支援。

countries: 這場衝突是印度與巴基斯坦之間在控制線一側第二次大規模的正面戰爭，1999年5月至7月發生在印控克什米爾拉達克地區的卡吉爾山區。印度一方以北方司令部為最高作戰指揮，陸軍投入8山地師、15山地師等山地步兵部隊，以及70步兵旅、192山地旅等旅級單位，中央武裝警察部隊與邊防警衛隊擔任後勤與高地警戒；空軍自5月26日起以「白海行動」代號提供空中火力，海軍則以「雙劍行動」在北阿拉伯海實施海上封鎖，企圖切斷巴基斯坦的石油與軍火進口。巴基斯坦一方由駐吉爾吉特的陸軍第12軍團策劃，滲入部隊以「北方之光步兵」四至七個營及特種服務團突擊隊為骨幹，並裹挾武裝分子擔任先鋒，其炮兵與補給自斯卡爾杜方向支援。雙方指揮體系的落差，是理解這場戰爭的關鍵：印軍在高海拔正面進攻，作戰單位主要落在旅與營；巴軍則以滲透加據點固守的方式，把兵力分散在數百個山頭堡壘之中，靠制高點的射界與封鎖公路的能力拖住對手，再等待政治條件成熟時收手。
countriesEn: This war was the second large-scale face-to-face conflict between India and Pakistan along the Line of Control, fought from May to July 1999 in the Kargil sector of Ladakh, in the Indian-administered part of Kashmir. On the Indian side the Northern Command held overall operational command. The Army committed the 8 Mountain Division, the 15 Mountain Division and other mountain infantry formations, together with brigade-level units such as the 70 Infantry Brigade and the 192 Mountain Brigade, while the Central Reserve Police Force and the border security troops handled rear-area security and high-altitude sentry duties. The Air Force entered the fight from 26 May under the code name Operation Safed Sagar, and the Navy ran Operation Talwar, a maritime blockade in the North Arabian Sea intended to choke off Pakistan's oil and arms imports. On the Pakistani side the operation was planned by the Army's 12 Corps headquarters at Gilgit. The infiltrating force was built around four to seven battalions of the Northern Light Infantry and commandos of the Special Services Group, with armed militants pressed into service as the spearhead, while artillery and sustainment pushed forward from Skardu. The gap between the two command systems is the key to reading this war: the Indian Army attacked head-on at high altitude with operations conducted mainly at brigade and battalion level, whereas the Pakistani Army combined infiltration with a stubborn garrison defence, dispersing its strength among hundreds of hilltop posts, relying on the observation arcs and the ability to cut the highway from the heights, and waiting for political conditions to ripen before pulling back.
people: 印方最高層是總理瓦杰帕伊與國防部長費爾南德斯，軍方由參謀長J. J. Singh少將主持，北方司令部司令J. F. R. Jacob中將全盤負責戰役，15軍團K. Pal中將與8山地師M. Puri少將分別指揮兩個方向；前任參謀長V. P. Malik將軍在戰後回憶錄中留下大量記錄。前線指揮官的表現最為突出：13查謨和喀什米爾步槍團長Y. K. Joshi中校於6月20日率部奪下5140號高點，隨後下令維克拉姆·巴特拉上尉投入攻堅；7月7日巴特拉中尉在4875號高點附近中冷槍與火箭彈陣亡，被救出的戰友納加帕上尉負重傷，兩人同獲param Vir Chakra。托洛林方向由K. S. Thakur中校率18擲彈兵團、1那加團與加爾瓦爾團進攻，6月14日奪回4590號高點，同役也是全軍傷亡最重的單役；其餘投入的精銳包括第6與第7空降團、旁遮普步兵、拉達克偵察隊與古爾加射擊手。空軍方面，K. Nachiketa上尉駕駛的米格-27在5月27日因引擎故障墜落並被俘，同日S. Ahuja少校駕駛的米格-21被擊落，遺體遭槍傷送回；空軍中唯一的女戰鬥機飛行員Gunjan Saxena亦在此役執行任務。巴方最具象徵性的兩名軍人是卡拉爾·謝爾·汗上尉（第27營信德團）與北方之光步兵的拉拉克·揚下士，陣亡後獲頒該國最高勳章尼尚-哈伊德爾；巴方另有約九十人獲英勇勳章，印方則頒出四枚param Vir Chakra與十一枚Maha Vir Chakra。戰局背後的關鍵人物還包括美國總統克林頓與其幕僚布魯斯·里德爾，以及巴基斯坦總理謝里夫與陸軍參謀長穆沙拉夫。
peopleEn: At the top of the Indian side stood Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Defence Minister George Fernandes, with Lt Gen J. J. Singh as Chief of the Army Staff, Lt Gen J. F. R. Jacob commanding the Northern Command, and Lt Gen K. Pal of the 15 Corps and Maj Gen M. Puri of the 8 Mountain Division running the two axes of effort; V. P. Malik, the outgoing Chief of the Army Staff, left a large body of memoir material on the campaign. The most striking command performance came from the front. Lt Col Y. K. Joshi of the 13 Jammu and Kashmir Rifles took Point 5140 with his battalion on 20 June and then committed Capt Vikram Batra to the assault; Batra was killed by sniper and rocket fire near Point 4875 on 7 July while pulling out the wounded Capt Naveen Nagappa, and both men were awarded the Param Vir Chakra. At Tololing, Col K. S. Thakur led 18 Grenadiers, 1 Naga and Garhwal Regiments and retook Point 4590 on 14 June in what was the costliest single action of the campaign for the Indian Army. Other committed formations included the 6th and 7th Parachute Regiments, the Punjab Regiment, the Ladakh Scouts and the Gurkha Rifles. In the air, Flt Lt K. Nachiketa lost a MiG-27 to engine failure and was captured on 27 May, the same day that Sqn Ldr Ahuja's MiG-21 was shot down and its pilot killed, his body returned riddled with bullets; Gunjan Saxena, the only female combat pilot in the Indian Air Force, also flew in this war. The two most emblematic Pakistani soldiers were Capt Karnal Sher Khan of the 27th Battalion, Sind Regiment, and Havildar Lalak Jan of the Northern Light Infantry, both posthumously awarded the Nishan-e-Haider; around ninety more Pakistani soldiers received gallantry awards, while India issued four Param Vir Chakras and eleven Maha Vir Chakras. Behind the fighting sat the decisive political figures: US President Bill Clinton and his aide Bruce Riedel, Pakistan's Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif, and its Chief of Army Staff Pervez Musharraf.
kits: 卡面這件BMP-2是蘇聯設計的步兵戰鬥車，也是巴基斯坦陸軍機械化步兵的核心裝甲載具，在這一役中扮演的角色，是守點部隊的近程火力支柱與反裝甲骨幹：車上的30公厘2A42機炮可在數百至上千公尺外壓制沿山脊接近的印度步兵，9M14「小魚」反裝甲導彈則可攻擊印軍坦克。由於高山地形只容許少數通道通行，巴軍把BMP-2集中在少數可通行的鞍部與岩石突出部，車體半埋或倚岩射擊，在毫無遮蔽的環境下成為活靶；在虎山、托洛林、黑岩這幾個關鍵點位究竟部署了多少輛BMP-2，雙方說法並不一致，但可以確定的是，制高點上的機炮火力正是印度步兵必須先用砲火與空軍炸彈壓制的對象。除BMP-2外，巴軍裝備還包括T-70坦克、中國製造的59與69式坦克、M-47與M-48巴頓坦克、105與130公厘榴砲及自走砲、RPG-7火箭筒、PKM機槍與AK-47及A-74步槍。印度方面的火力支撐以Bofors FH-77B 155公厘牽引榴砲與M777榴砲為主，另有自走砲、直瞄反裝甲武器與Mi-24「雌鹿」武裝直升機攜帶的反坦克導彈；空中方面，印度空軍出動米格-21、米格-27、米格-29、Su-30與幻象2000，後者自5月30日起投擲雷射導引炸彈對付堅固堡壘，巴方則有F-16、幻象III與殲-7可用。海軍由護衛艦、飛彈驅逐艦、多用途機與潛艦封鎖卡拉奇一帶，並攔截載有軍火的北韓商船。
kitsEn: The BMP-2 on the card face is a Soviet-designed infantry fighting vehicle and the core armoured carrier of the Pakistani Army's mechanised infantry, and in this campaign its role was that of the short-range fire pillar and anti-armour backbone of the garrison: the 30 mm 2A42 autocannon aboard could suppress Indian infantry moving up a ridge at ranges of several hundred to more than a thousand metres, and the 9M14 Malyutka anti-tank guided missiles could engage Indian tanks. Because the high ground allowed only a few passable tracks, the Pakistanis concentrated their BMP-2s on the few usable saddles and rock outcrops, half-buried or parked against the rock and firing from there, which made them conspicuous targets in terrain offering no cover. How many BMP-2s were deployed at which key points such as Tiger Hill, Tololing or Black Rock is not consistently reported by either side, but what is certain is that the autocannon fire from the heights was exactly what the Indian infantry had to suppress with artillery and air strikes first. Beyond the BMP-2, the Pakistani inventory included T-70 tanks, Chinese Type 59 and Type 69 tanks, M-47 and M-48 Patton tanks, 105 mm and 130 mm howitzers and self-propelled guns, RPG-7 launchers, PKM machine guns and AK-47 and A-74 rifles. On the Indian side the fire support base rested mainly on the Bofors FH-77B 155 mm towed howitzer and the M777, backed by self-propelled guns, direct-fire anti-armour weapons and anti-tank missiles carried by Mi-24 Hind helicopters. In the air, the Indian Air Force flew MiG-21, MiG-27, MiG-29, Su-30 and Mirage 2000, the last of which began dropping laser-guided bombs against fortified positions from 30 May, while Pakistan could field F-16s, Mirage IIIs and J-7s. At sea the Indian Navy blockaded the approaches to Karachi with frigates, missile destroyers, maritime patrol aircraft and submarines, and intercepted a North Korean merchant ship carrying weapons.
tactics: 這是一場教科書式的高山攻守戰：控制線一側的山脊線直接俯瞰斯利那加至列城的公路，高地守方只要有一門機炮就能封鎖整條補給線，所以印軍的第一步不是奪點，而是先用砲火與空軍把守點打瞎。印軍5月25日獲准有限使用空軍，5月26日「白海行動」展開，幻象2000自5月30日起以雷射導引炸彈對堡壘實施晝夜連續精確轟炸；巴方空軍全程未升空攔截，制空權完全歸印方，空軍因此得以反覆修正射擊諸元，對固定目標反覆打擊。地面進攻以步兵徒步攀上五千公尺山脊為主，每個點位都要先搜索，再用爆破器材清除拒馬與地雷，之後以班、排為單位沿山脊逐段交替躍進。7月初的虎山戰役中，因單一營兵力不足，8錫克營自西側迂回進入同一山脊，18擲彈兵團自東側攻擊，最終把整個山頭連同其射擊陣位一併拿下。守方的典型手法是把步兵藏進堡壘，BMP-2與砲位分開配置，等印度攻擊梯隊進入近距離才以機炮與火箭筒同時開火。補給端是另一場戰爭：高原上沒有道路，糧秣、彈藥與傷員全靠「獅子」式與「羚羊」式直升機在山口與前進陣地之間做接力運送，人力與騾馬搬運仍佔相當比重。7月12日停火生效後交火一度再起，7月27日雙方舉行旗會收殮遺體，戰線才真正收束。
tacticsEn: This was a textbook high-altitude fight. The ridge line on the Indian side of the Line of Control looked straight down onto the Srinagar-Leh highway, so a single autocannon on the heights could cut the entire supply route; the Indian Army therefore did not begin by seizing points but by blinding the garrisons with artillery and air strikes. Limited use of air power was cleared on 25 May, Operation Safed Sagar opened on 26 May, and from 30 May the Mirage 2000s ran continuous day-and-night precision bombing with laser-guided bombs against the bunkers. The Pakistan Air Force never rose to contest it, so the Indian Air Force held absolute air superiority, could keep refining its aiming indices and repeatedly revisit the same static targets. On the ground, the assault was made on foot up ridges of five thousand metres: every point had to be searched, then cleared of stakes and mines with demolitions, after which platoons and sections advanced along the crest in bounding movement. In the battle for Tiger Hill in early July, one battalion proved insufficient, so 8 Sikh was ordered in from the west into the same ridge while 18 Grenadiers attacked from the east, and the whole feature, with its firing positions, was taken. The typical defending method was to shelter the infantry inside the bunkers, place BMP-2s and gun positions separately, and wait until the Indian assault columns were close before opening up with cannon and rockets at once. Supply was a war of its own: with no roads on the plateau, rations, ammunition and casualties moved by Cheetah and Dhruv helicopters shuttling between the passes and the forward positions, and porters and mules still carried a substantial share. Fighting flared again after the 12 July ceasefire, and only a flag meeting on 27 July to recover the dead closed the front for good.
data: 可核對的數字集中在四組。時間上，滲入自1999年2月展開，主要兵力於4月投入，5月上旬被發現，5月18日內閣安全委員會會議後全面動員，7月12日停火、7月26日德拉斯戰區清剿結束、7月27日舉行收殮遺體的旗會，全役前後不足三個月。地面方面，巴軍佔據約130至200平方公里山區、130個以上觀察與堡壘哨位，滲入部隊連同後勤支援約五千人；印方一次動員二十萬兵力，實際投入卡吉爾與德拉斯戰區的兵員接近三萬，其中兩個師約兩萬人，另有數千武裝警察與空軍部隊。火力方面，印軍在前線投入約二百五十門野戰砲與榴砲。傷亡方面，印方公布的官方數字為陣亡527人、受傷1,363人；巴方數字分歧極大，穆沙拉夫稱357人，美國國務院早期估計接近700人，總理謝里夫則稱逾4,000人，其政黨白皮書列逾3,000人。俘虜方面，共有八名巴軍人員被俘，1999年8月13日全部遣返；勳章方面，印方有四枚param Vir Chakra與十一枚Maha Vir Chakra，巴方頒出兩枚尼尚-哈伊德爾另有約九十項英勇勳章。地理上，卡吉爾距斯利那加205公里，距巴方控制的重鎮斯卡爾杜173公里，公路沿線哨位多在五千公尺上下，最高者達5,485公尺，冬季氣溫可低至攝氏零下48度。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers fall into four groups. On timing: the infiltration was prepared from February 1999, the bulk of the force was committed in April, the presence was detected in early May, mobilisation became general after the Cabinet Committee on Security meeting of 18 May, the ceasefire took effect on 12 July, the Dras sector was cleared by 26 July and a flag meeting to recover the dead was held on 27 July, so the whole campaign lasted a little under three months. On the ground: the Pakistani side seized roughly 130 to 200 square kilometres of mountain and more than 130 observation and bunker positions, and the infiltrating force numbered about five thousand including the logistics echelon; India mobilised two hundred thousand troops in all and committed close to thirty thousand to the Kargil and Dras sector, of whom about twenty thousand formed two divisions, with several thousand paramilitary troops and the Air Force in support. On firepower: some two hundred and fifty field and medium howitzers were brought into the Indian front line. On casualties: India's official figures were 527 dead and 1,363 wounded, while the Pakistani numbers diverge sharply, with Pervez Musharraf giving 357, an early US Department of State estimate close to 700, Prime Minister Sharif claiming more than 4,000, and his party's white paper listing more than 3,000. On prisoners and awards: eight Pakistani personnel were taken prisoner and all were repatriated on 13 August 1999; India awarded four Param Vir Chakras and eleven Maha Vir Chakras, and Pakistan two Nishan-e-Haiders together with about ninety other gallantry awards. On geography: Kargil lies 205 km from Srinagar and 173 km from the Pakistani-held town of Skardu, the outposts above the road generally stood around five thousand metres with a few as high as 5,485 metres, and winter temperatures fell to minus 48 degrees Celsius.
cause: 導火線是控制線歸屬與克什米爾主權爭議，直接原因則是1998至1999年冬季的滲透作戰。1997年西姆拉協定確立的控制線，在印方看來已是南北克什米爾的事實邊界；1990年代印巴衝突與分裂活動不斷，1998年兩國相繼核試炸，1999年2月又簽署拉合爾宣言，雙方一度以為克什米爾問題可以談判解決。就在這個氣氛下，巴基斯坦陸軍自行推動代號「巴德爾」的滲透計畫，目標是切斷克什米爾與拉達克之間的道路連結，逼印度從錫亞琴冰川撤軍，並把克什米爾問題推上國際議程；總理謝里夫是否知情、軍方如何繞過政府決策，說法不一，陸軍參謀長穆沙拉夫則聲稱已提前通報。滲入以武裝分子面孔在冬季雪季秘密登上山脊，行動本身由巴方側的砲火提供掩護。1999年5月，巴塔里克方向一支印軍巡邏隊在牧羊人告知下遭伏擊，隊長S. Kalia陣亡，滲透才曝光。情報估算一路膨脹：5月12日參謀部仍報「少量武裝分子」，5月15日升至250至300人，5月21日已逾一千。5月18日內閣安全委員會會議之後，印度才真正理解對手是正規軍而非游擊隊。
causeEn: The flashpoint was the status of the Line of Control and the sovereignty dispute over Kashmir; the immediate cause was the winter infiltration of 1998-1999. The Line of Control fixed by the Simla Agreement of 1972 was, in Indian eyes, already the effective boundary between the two Kashmirs. The 1990s had brought a decade of armed friction and of the separatist insurgency, both states had tested nuclear devices in 1998, and the Lahore Declaration of February 1999 had left both sides briefly convinced that Kashmir could be settled by negotiation. Against that background the Pakistani Army pressed ahead with an infiltration plan of its own, codenamed Operation Badr, whose aims were to sever the road link between Kashmir and Ladakh, force an Indian withdrawal from the Siachen Glacier and internationalise the Kashmir issue. Whether Prime Minister Sharif knew of it, and how the army bypassed civilian decision-making, remains disputed; Pervez Musharraf asserted that he had briefed the prime minister in advance. The infiltration climbed the ridges secretly during the winter, disguised as militants, with covering fire from Pakistani artillery positions. It was exposed in May 1999, when an Indian patrol in the Batalik sector was ambushed after a local shepherd provided a tip-off and its commander, Capt S. Kalia, was killed. The intelligence estimate then grew steadily: on 12 May the directorate was still reporting a few militants, by 15 May it had risen to 250 or 300 men, and by 21 May it exceeded a thousand. Only after the meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Security on 18 May did India grasp that it was facing regular troops rather than guerrillas.
impact: 卡吉爾之役是兩個核國家之間少數的全面常規戰爭之一，直接改變了南亞的戰略與外交。軍事上，印軍奪回約七成半至八成被佔山區與幾乎全部制高點，卻暴露兩個短板：高海拔後勤與精確空中打擊能力不足。這一課直接催生印軍後續的裝備更新、兵種調整與空軍打擊規範的修正，北方山區的常備防衛與砲兵射界計算亦被重新檢視。外交上，巴基斯坦因越線進攻而在國際上被廣泛批評，一度陷入孤立；美國總統克林頓在幕僚布魯斯·里德爾報告美方情報偵察到巴方核武前推之後，仍以「先撤軍」為前提才介入，7月4日達成華盛頓協議，謝里夫同意撤出。巴軍退回控制線，成為核門檻國家在主動出擊之後被迫收手的示範，雙方此後的核姿態與危機管理都更趨謹慎。克什米爾游擊戰爭並未因卡吉爾而停止，反被國際社會視為不安全根源，長期消耗仍在延續；印巴之間的民用航空與鐵路聯運則在1999年底至2000年初逐步恢復。德拉斯城外的卡吉爾紀念碑於2000年落成，門楣上題有印度詩人馬坎拉爾·查圖維迪的詩句，兩國民間對這場戰爭的記憶至今仍是爭議所在。
impactEn: Kargil was one of the few full-scale conventional wars between two nuclear-armed states, and it directly reshaped South Asian strategy and diplomacy. Militarily the Indian Army recovered roughly 75 to 80 per cent of the occupied ground and almost all of the high ground, yet it exposed two weaknesses: logistics at high altitude and the ability to deliver precision air strikes. The lesson drove procurement, force restructuring and a revision of air-strike doctrine in the years that followed, and the permanent defence of the northern heights and the calculation of artillery arcs of fire were re-examined. Diplomatically, Pakistan was widely criticised for crossing the line and came close to international isolation; after Bruce Riedel reported that US intelligence had detected the forward movement of Pakistani nuclear weapons, President Clinton would only intervene on the condition that the troops went home first, and the Washington Accord of 4 July was concluded with Sharif agreeing to withdraw. The Pakistani Army fell back to the line, and the image of a threshold nuclear state forced to climb down after an offensive became a warning that made the nuclear postures and crisis management of both sides more cautious afterwards. The insurgency in Kashmir did not end with Kargil and was treated internationally as a source of instability, with the attrition continuing, while civil air links and the rail service between the two countries were gradually restored from late 1999 into early 2000. The Kargil memorial outside Dras was completed in 2000, its gateway carrying a verse by the Hindi poet Makhanlal Chaturvedi, and the memory of the war remains contested on both sides of the border.
result: 結果是巴基斯坦在山區的既得陣地被逐點拔除。印度方面自5月18日之後依序奪回托洛林（6月14日4590號高點）、三峰地區（6月29日，由2拉賈普塔納步槍團攻下）、5140號高點（6月20日）、4875號高點（7月上旬），以及巴塔里克方向的5203、4812與朱巴爾峰等目標；7月3日展開的虎山戰役中，18擲彈兵團與8錫克營在41野戰砲團與空軍配合下於7月4日至8日之間完全拿下整個山頭陣地。停火於7月12日生效，但巴方仍有殘部在朱爾尖峰等據點頑抗，印軍於7月22日至25日攻下該處，7月26日德拉斯戰區清剿完成，7月27日雙方舉行旗會收殮遺體，印方並將7月26日定為卡吉爾勝利日。官方統計，印方收復被滲入區域約七成半至八成，制高點幾乎全數奪回；被俘的八名巴軍人員於8月13日遣返。外交上，7月4日華盛頓協議之後巴方全面撤出控制線以東，控制線的現況維持至今；克什米爾爭議本身並未解決，卡吉爾之後的另一輪危機很快又在2016年與2019年重演。戰役的軍事遺產則相當明確：像BMP-2這類裝甲車在毫無遮蔽的山脊上守不住位置，而能夠長時間壓制高地的砲兵與空軍，才是高山戰爭中真正的決定性力量。
resultEn: The outcome was the methodical recovery, point by point, of the ground Pakistan had gained in the mountains. From 18 May the Indian Army retook Tololing, including Point 4590 on 14 June, the Three Pimples area on 29 June, taken by 2 Rajputana Rifles, Point 5140 on 20 June, Point 4875 in the first days of July, and in the Batalik sector Points 5203 and 4812 together with Jubar Peak. In the battle for Tiger Hill that opened on 3 July, 18 Grenadiers and 8 Sikh, supported by 41 Field Regiment artillery and the Air Force, took the entire feature between 4 and 8 July. The ceasefire took effect on 12 July, but Pakistani parties still held at places such as Zulu Spur, where the Indian Army fought from 22 to 25 July; the Dras sector was cleared by 26 July, a flag meeting to recover the dead was held on 27 July, and India marks 26 July as Kargil Vijay Diwas. Officially, India recovered some 75 to 80 per cent of the intruded area and virtually all of the commanding heights, and the eight captured Pakistani personnel were repatriated on 13 August. Diplomatically, after the Washington Accord of 4 July the Pakistanis withdrew completely from the Indian side of the Line of Control, and that line remains where it was drawn until this day; the Kashmir dispute itself was not settled, and further rounds of crisis followed in 2016 and 2019. The military lesson is clear enough: an armoured vehicle such as the BMP-2 cannot hold a position on an open ridge, whereas artillery and air power that can bear on a height for hours are the genuinely decisive force in high-altitude war.
